text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm♪ Hmmm♪ Hmm-hm-hmmmm～～～♪
……Alrighty, all set!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……Oh my. What happened to you?
Where did our usual sleepyhead go?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe～, Heart-chan, good mornin'～☆
Looking for a hug?
An energy-charging hug of love♡

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No way! Last time when you whined,
『Oka Sho was the absolute worst～!
Cheer me up～!』,
you came begging for hugs even during bath
time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
……You mentioned you were transferring over
to <Ascella>, right?
Do you really think things will go
smoothly?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Course they will———!
Who d'you think I am? Total genius~!
From here on out,
everything's gonna get better and better
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(That's right,
this is where it all truly begins!
From now on,
it's a straight dash straight to a sparkling
future!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Everything up until now,
well…… some stuff just kinda happened——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(No, no, but still! In the very beginning,
things were going so super well, you know?
I mean, I am a genius! Ever since coming here,
it's been nothing but smooth sailing!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(That Debut Selection Race was an effortless
1st place, wasn't it?
And someone came to scout me in a heartbeat,
right?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Plus there were so many amazing senpais,
it was such a wonderful team——)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there she is! Pandora-chan～!
Good job in the 『Flower Cup』 earlier!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe～, Bono-senpai, thank you～☆
And Mirako-senpai came to cheer me on too,
right? Thanks a bunch♡

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, no～. 2nd place, you came so close,
huh?
……Ah, but still,
getting 2nd in a Classic-grade graded race
is pretty amazing on its own, isn't it～?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
in your debut you won by a whopping 6 lengths,
and then you went straight into the race
that crowns the Junior queen, the 『Hanshin JF』,
and grabbed 3rd place!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well～,
it took me like 10 whole races just to get
my first win,
so I'd say that's a seriously impressive
record～.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe～ I see, I see,
I see! Just as expected of little old me,
I guess～?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So far, 6 races with 2 wins,
and I've only missed the board a single time!
Whoa, amazing! No way! Pure genius～♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And from here on out,
I'm just gonna keep charging forward!
I'm gonna become a living legend!
Just keep your eyes on me～☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, we're all rooting for you♪
Now then,
shall we get started on today's training?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay～♡ ……Ah, senpai,
have you stopped by the shop today?
They had some brand new items that were
super-duper cute——

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
……Alright, Pandora.
Up next is finally the first leg of the
Triple Tiara, the 『Oka Sho』.
We need to go into this more motivated than
ever.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
First,
let me go over the new training regimen.
Until final adjustments,
we'll be focusing on high-intensity
workloads——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, Trainer,
hold on～! In prep for such a mega-huge race,
isn't there something far more important we
gotta do first?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Step one!
Gotta get our spirits pumped up———☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha, come on, everyone, over here～!
Let's ride that attraction next～～～!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah wah, wait, hold on～!
Pandora-chan,
is it really okay for you to be goofing off
like this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Starting tomorrow,
you've got serious training for the 『Oka Sho』,
right?
Won't you end up exhausted……?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I'm telling you, it'll be totally fine☆
Come on, come on, Mirako-senpai, you too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha…… Well, if it gets her pumped up,
I guess it's okay…… maybe?
Okaaay～, wait for me～.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
No way in hell that's okay.
Dammit, that Pandora……

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That girl hasn't taken a single thing
seriously this whole damn time…… She's always
slacking off like this.
Is she really gonna be fine?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Quite the untamed pony-chan,
isn't she?
Even though Trainer-san pleaded with her,
she still ran off to play.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That being said——
her raw potential truly is something to look
forward to.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! In our last team time trials,
her recorded times were outstanding,
weren't they?
Compared to the Classic-class spring baseline,
she's definitely a cut above.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
……Which is precisely why we cannot let this
continue.
Especially if her goal is to take the crown
in the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
At this rate…… coasting purely on raw talent
without putting in the genuine sweat and
discipline,
what awaits her is almost certainly——

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
——Now then, Fusaichi Pandora-san,
the 『Oka Sho』 is finally upon us!
Could you share your thoughts going into
the race?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay♡ My thoughts, you say?
Well, obviously——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm a bona fide genius.
So I won't just be sweeping the 『Oka
Sho』——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The "Triple Tiara" too!
I fully intend to seize the whole thing♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ——『That's why♡』——『That's why』——『Why』——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ……Why?

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
——In the 『Oka Sho』,
2nd-favorite Fusaichi Pandora crashes into
a shocking 14th place finish! A crushing,
utter defeat……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whyyyyyyy～～～～～～～?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaaagh~~~!
Are you kidding me——————!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh～ geez, I hate this,
hate it hate it hate it,
this is the absolute wooooorst……!
How on earth did things end up like
this～……?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(Seriously,
a total blowout loss in the 『Oka Sho』?!
Even though I'm a genius!
All those crowns were supposed to be
mine～……!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(And I went and made such a big declaration!
To my senpais on the team, my classmates,
my parents…… and at the press conference in
front of everyone!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(『I'll claim the Triple Tiara～』……
This is so, so,
so…… incredibly mortifying～～～～!)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
……Aaaagh——— dammit!
Can't take this anymore!
I'm so done with this—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah! There she is! Pandora-chan～……!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eh? ……Huh, senpais. What's wrong?
And why are you still in your school uniforms?
Isn't it time for training?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You…… you really haven't checked the team
LANE at all, have you?
C'mon, whatever you're wearing is fine,
just come with us.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Go where? ……Wah, hold on!
Wh-What are you doing～?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? An 『Oka Sho』 review meeting～～～?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
……What's with that "Huuuh?"
Of course we have to do this.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san compiled tons of footage from
so many different angles,
you know～! Let's sit down, watch it together,
and talk it over.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no,
video footage?! From every single angle?!
That's just gonna be tape after tape of me
getting totally humiliated, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way,
no way! I'm not watching that again～～～!

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text: Pandora! ……Please, just listen to me.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I deeply regret not guiding you properly……
Though in a sense,
this outcome was 『inevitable』.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
When preparing for the 『Oka Sho』…… you never
once ran at full effort,
did you?
You never once took your training
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara isn't something you can
conquer with such a half-hearted attitude.
……That is why we must reflect on this and
work together for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Facing your defeat in the 『Oka Sho』 and
reviewing your race is an essential first step.
……It's alright, take a seat, Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: …………No way. I'm not watching.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Wh—…… Wait,
Pandora! Running off like that——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way! No way no way no way,
absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Not serious,
not easy!
What's that even supposed to mean!
Don't get it, no way no way no way———!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, Pandora-chan?! Oh jeez～～～……
Um, well…… shouldn't we go chase after
her……?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No…… let's give her some space.
If we chase after her now,
she'll only run further away.
……What do you think, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
……You're right.
My words won't reach her as things stand.

text_block_list.name: Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I will…… take some time to think.
About what I can do for her,
and what is truly best for Pandora——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*. ……I don't get it.
I don't understand any of it,
I hate this so much, ugh～～～ dammit!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Daaaaah～～～～!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Kyaah?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Whoa?!
